messages:
eli-support: Customer (acct: acme-inc) reporting sudden tail latency (~800-1200ms) and intermittent 401s. They were pinned to eu-west, but we see routing to us-east1. Sample req ids: req_01F..., req_01G... Pls triage. :wave:

prod-monitor-bot: ALERT eu-west-1 pool queue depth=1275, utilization=98% -> auto-spillover to us-east1 (policy=spillover-latency). Started at 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z. Affected model: gpt-large-1-8k.

sam.k: can you paste one failing request id and a minimal repro? do we have auth errors classified (invalid_token vs invalid_audience)?

eli-support: failing req id `req_01G9V...` — logs show 401 from auth-service with reason `invalid_audience`. Customer uses regional tokens scoped to `aud:eu-west-1`. Repro command:

```:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN_REGIONAL" -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-large-1-8k","input":"hello"}'
```

ashley-oncall: looks like fallback routing is sending traffic to us-east1 but the auth service enforces audience matching and rejects eu-regional tokens. When auto-spillover routes cross-zone we currently do not rewrite/validate regional audience. That causes 401s + extra latency. Temporary mitigation: 1) relax audience check for spillover pool, 2) pin this customer to dedicated capacity, or 3) throttle spillover by increasing soft limit. Recommend quick mitigation (1) until we push a safer fix.

sam.k: do we have an auth log line showing `invalid_audience` for that req id? that will confirm.

eli-support: auth log snippet for `req_01G9V...`: `2026-03-15T18:12:04Z auth-service ERROR req=req_01G9V status=401 err=invalid_audience token_aud=eu-west-1 target_pool=us-east1`

marcos-prod: customer also flagged a billing jump from cross-region egress. Need comms and a short RCA. Prioritize rollback changes if needed. @ashley-oncall can you estimate blast radius?

ashley-oncall: blast radius ~12 customers on eu-west1 active at peak; spillover window ~4m; billing exposure ~$2-5k depending on egress. Plan: (A) short-term: relax audience check for fallback pools + add audit log; (B) mid-term: route tokens with regional claims to compatible pools or inject regional-claim-mapping; (C) ops: increase eu-west soft capacity and adjust autoscale thresholds. I'll open an incident and assign follow-ups.

eli-support: thanks — opening CS ticket and pinging account team. I'll attach repro steps and ask customer if they can tolerate temporary pinning. :thumbsup:

sam.k: assign to runtime/auth ownership for a patch to handle regional audience mapping. I'll take the auth patch review.

ashley-oncall: created incident INC-4321, added runbook steps and temporary mitigation. Will update within 15m.

eli-support: appreciated, will update customer.
